symptom: vcgencmd get_throttled returns 0x1 and my Pi is unstable right now (USB devices drop). I thought bit 16 meant 'has occurred in the past', so why is it 0x1?

gold.diagnosis: get_throttled bit 0 is 'under-voltage NOW' (currently active), not bit 16 (which means 'has occurred since boot'). 0x1 means the supply is too low at this moment. This is a power-supply problem, not code. STOP coding; use a 5V/3A+ PSU and don't draw peripherals from the Pi rail.
